name: mcp-remote
description: Connects stdio-only MCP clients such as Claude Desktop to remote MCP servers, handling OAuth sign-in, custom auth headers, and transports.

skills.name: Proxy Remote Server
skills.description: Proxies a remote MCP server over stdio so clients that only launch local servers can use hosted MCP endpoints.

skills.name: OAuth Sign-In
skills.description: Signs in to remote servers with OAuth in the browser, by device code, or with client credentials, and refreshes the tokens.

skills.name: Custom Headers
skills.description: Sends custom headers, such as an Authorization bearer token, on every request from --header flags or a header file.

skills.name: Transport Strategy
skills.description: Chooses how to reach the server, such as SSE only or HTTP first, with the --transport flag for older and newer servers.

skills.name: Isolate OAuth Sessions
skills.description: Keeps separate OAuth sessions and tokens for several instances of one server, such as two Atlassian tenants, via --resource.
